name: Forma Headphones
description: Over-ear wireless headphones with adaptive noise cancellation, 40-hour battery and a soft mineral finish. An everyday companion for long train journeys and focused work.

name: Pebble Speaker
description: A pocket-sized waterproof Bluetooth speaker with warm sound and a woven carry loop. 14-hour battery for a weekend away.

name: Memo Pocket Camera
description: A compact digital camera with a 24MP sensor, USB-C charging and a tactile analogue-inspired design. Made for everyday memories.

name: Rive Canvas Tote
description: A generous recycled cotton canvas tote with a zipped interior pocket. Lightweight, strong and ready for a Paris market morning.

name: Source Steel Bottle
description: A double-wall stainless steel bottle. Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours, with a leakproof sculpted cap and 600ml capacity.

name: Atelier Notebook
description: A lay-flat A5 notebook with 160 pages of responsibly sourced dotted paper. A quiet place for new ideas, sketches and plans.

name: Arc Travel Charger
description: A compact 65W GaN charger with two USB-C ports and EU plug. Powers a laptop and phone from one beautifully small device.

name: Tempo Watch
description: A minimal analogue watch with a recycled stainless steel case, sapphire-coated glass and an interchangeable fabric strap.

name: Metro Daypack
description: A weather-resistant 18L daypack with a padded laptop sleeve and hidden commuter pocket. Recycled fabric, thoughtful details.

name: Soleil Sunglasses
description: Lightweight bio-acetate frames with polarised UV400 lenses. A timeless shape for bright days in the city.

name: Nuage Scarf
description: An airy merino-blend scarf in warm earth tones. Soft, breathable and versatile for cooler Paris evenings.

name: Echo Earbuds
description: Lightweight wireless earbuds with balanced sound, clear calls and a pebble charging case. 28 hours of listening, wherever you go.
